input.brief: EchoFlow, an open-source Android AI chat app: any model (OpenRouter, direct keys, on-device, your own Ollama PC), voice calls, image and video generation, deep research, projects, seven accent themes

direction.name: The dark room
direction.idea: One dark field from top to bottom, and in it, lit things. Photographs and objects appear like exhibits in a dim gallery: each with space around it, each the brightest thing on its screen. Type is light, small and sparse. The darkness is not a theme switch; it is a room, and the page is a slow walk through it. It suits subjects sold on atmosphere and material: an evening restaurant, a metal card, a record, a house at dusk.
direction.composition: A single near-black or deep-toned ground runs the full page with no section bands. First screen: either the name at full width in a light weight along the bottom edge with one dim photograph above it, or one object or photograph centred at 40–50% of the viewport with a line of text beneath at 16–18px. Each later screen holds one or two lit items at a generous size (the main one 40–60% of the screen width) with its text set beside it at full reading size; the darkness frames the items, it does not replace content. Images vary in size but all share the same darkness at their edges so they sit in the ground without frames. Practical details come last in a simple two-column text block. The only solid light element on the page is the single primary action.
direction.typography: Light or regular weights; they glow on dark. Avoid heavy bold, which looks cheap on black. Headings 4–7vw at most; text 16–18px with leading 1.6 and a slightly lifted ink (not pure white).
direction.colour: A dark ground with a tint (blue-black, green-black, brown-black), a soft light ink, a dimmer ink for secondary text, and one warm or bright accent used once per screen at most.
direction.imagery: Low-key photographs: dark backgrounds, one light source, subjects emerging from shadow. Their dark edges should blend into the page ground.
direction.photoTreatment: If a photograph's background is lighter than the page, darken the image slightly (`filter: brightness(0.85) contrast(1.05)`) rather than adding a frame.
direction.richness: Light against dark, and the slow pacing.
direction.pitfalls: Grey text on black fails contrast quickly: check it. No glow effects, no neon accent, no coloured light blobs. A dark page with a bright busy photograph is not this direction; choose low-key images. Dark does not mean empty: every screen still carries its content at a readable size, and running text is a light ink at 7:1 or more, not a dim grey.

hero.name: Title from the top edge to the bottom edge
hero.blueprint: One full-bleed photograph or film at 100vw by 100svh, with a horizon near half height and empty sky or darkness above. The headline is two lines in a heavy face at clamp(140px, 13vw, 200px), leading 0.85, pulled as far apart as the screen allows: line one flush to the 32px left margin with its cap line 72px from the top; line two indented 28vw (403px) and anchored to the bottom, its baseline 24px above the lower edge, running towards the right margin. Lay the hero out as a grid of three rows (`grid-template-rows: auto 1fr auto`): line one in the first row, line two in the third, both spans of one `h1` with `display: contents`. The middle row leaves the picture clear apart from one supporting sentence at 18px, max 44ch, crossing the horizon at 48% of the height from 30vw, and the single action directly beneath it as a solid rectangular button with its label at 18px. The wordmark and two text links sit top-right on the 32px margin at 15px; the top-left belongs to line one. Choose a picture whose upper-left and lower-right are calm enough for the type, or lay a neutral scrim under those two corners only.
hero.mobile: Keep the two lines at 19vw: line one flush left on a 16px margin 88px down, line two right-aligned to the 16px margin with its baseline 20px above the bottom. The sentence at 17px and the action button sit between them on the left margin, at 46% of the height. The picture is re-cropped to portrait around the horizon.
hero.headline: Two words or short phrases, one per line, at most about 8 characters each.

type.note: A true didone with hairline serifs and vertical stress over a light geometric sans, the classic fashion-magazine pairing. Suits luxury property, jewellery, fragrance and fashion.

palette.name: Charcoal and sage
palette.note: Charcoal holds the page with off-white text, and one section may flip to a pale concrete tone with dark text. Colour comes from the photographs; grey sage is used for the single button and the active state of a control.

photos.title: Water
photos.note: lakes, rivers, waterfalls and water surfaces
photos.treatment: If a photograph's background is lighter than the page, darken the image slightly (`filter: brightness(0.85) contrast(1.05)`) rather than adding a frame.

motion.name: Masked headline
motion.description: On load, each line of the headline rises from behind its own baseline, about 900ms with a strong ease-out, the second line 110ms after the first; the supporting sentence and the action then fade up together. Nothing else on the page performs. Because headlines are two lines at most, you author the line breaks and wrap each line yourself. Recipe: 'Masked line reveal' in references/motion.md.

sections.name: Lit panel, dark row
sections.blueprint: One dark field, 96svh tall. Across its middle runs a horizontal row of five to seven interface panels, each a different true-size fragment marked data-ui (an open menu, an inspector, a composer, a chart card), 320–460px wide at their natural heights, vertically centred and 26vw apart. The row scrolls sideways with scroll-snap-type: x mandatory and scroll-snap-align: center, and can be dragged. Only the panel at the centre is lit: full opacity, in the product's light theme, the brightest thing on screen. The others sit at 22% opacity and are inert. The viewport's edges crop the outermost panels. In the gap to the right of the centred panel, top-aligned with it, a 24ch column gives its name at 24px in a light weight and two lines at 16px in a lifted ink; this text changes as panels arrive. There is no heading above the row.
sections.mobile: The row is 62svh tall; panels snap one per screen at true size, capped at 86vw wide, with neighbours showing 7vw at each side at 22% opacity. The name and its two lines sit beneath the row on the left margin and change with the centred panel. Swiping moves the row.

sections.name: Fixed output, live controls
sections.blueprint: A split the reader operates. Left, columns 1–6: a flat colour field that is position: sticky; top: 0; height: 100svh, edge to edge, holding one thing the product makes (a card, an email, a chart, a rendered page) centred at true size, about 420px wide, root marked data-ui. Right, columns 8–12: a reading column no wider than 44ch, with four or five capability blocks 50vh apart. Each block is a sentence at 28–32px, a paragraph at 17px, and directly beneath it one real control at interface size: a slider, a segmented choice, a toggle, a short text field. Operating a control changes the fixed output on the left at once, and changes persist, so by the last block the reader has configured their own. The section heading, two to four words at 40–44px, opens the right column, 72px from the top.
sections.mobile: The output sits in a sticky field at the top, 42svh tall, cropped to its most telling region, not shrunk. Blocks scroll beneath on the page ground: sentence at 22px, paragraph at 16px, control at full width with 44px targets. The field releases after the last block.

sections.name: Call and response column
sections.blueprint: The sequence is shown as what you give and what comes back, in one narrow column 560px wide starting at column 4, or on the page's text axis. Three exchanges, 88px apart. Each opens with a sentence at 20px medium that begins with its order word ('First, install it.' 'Then ask for a chart.'). 16px under it, the call: the literal thing the user enters, in a filled panel one tone off the ground, radius 8px, padding 20px. For a developer tool that is real code in `<pre><code>` at 14px with a working copy button; otherwise it is the product's own input holding real typed text. Under the call, indented 56px, the response: a true-size fragment marked data-ui showing what the product returns. The third response is the finished result and breaks out of the column, 760px wide, running to column 12. The heading, two to four words at 28px, sits 56px above the first sentence.
sections.mobile: The column fills the width with 20px margins. Calls and responses stack without the indent; a 24px gap and a lighter panel tone set the response apart. Code panels scroll sideways inside themselves. The final result runs edge to edge at true size, cropped on the right if wider.

sections.name: First step, already open
sections.blueprint: The page ends with the product's first screen already open. A full-bleed field in the accent colour, 90svh tall. Right, in columns 7–11, vertically centred: the product's own create dialog at true size, 440px wide, root marked data-ui, with its real title ('Name your workspace'), one text field holding an editable, believable example, one two-option segmented choice and its primary button. Inside the fragment the product's conventions apply, including the shadow its dialog normally casts. The field accepts typing, the choice switches, and the primary button is the page's only action: it carries the typed value into sign-up. Left, in columns 1–5, anchored to the bottom with 40px margins: the closing line, two to four words at clamp(56px, 7vw, 112px), leading 0.92, on two lines, and under it one sentence at 17px saying what happens after the button. The upper-left stays empty.
sections.mobile: The closing line leads at 13vw on two lines, top-left, with its sentence beneath at 16px. The dialog follows at full width inside 16px margins, at true size, its primary button 52px tall and full width. The field is at least 84svh; the dialog sits in its lower half.

sections.name: Columns above, wordmark below
sections.blueprint: The footer inverts ground and ink and fills a whole viewport (min-height 100svh), arranged as three rows in a grid (auto 1fr auto). Top row, 40px from the edge: four small columns on the 12-column grid (address, navigation, social, hours or contact), each a plain list at 15–16px with its first line in the full ink and the rest in the softer ink. Middle row: empty. Bottom row: the wordmark alone, sized to run from the left margin to the right margin on one line. Set it as inline SVG text with a `viewBox` fitted to the word and `width: 100%`, or tune `font-size` in `vw` to the letter count, so it never wraps; its baseline sits 20px above a single line of legal text at 13px. With `position: sticky; bottom: 0` and a lower `z-index` than the page, the last section slides away to uncover it.
sections.mobile: Columns become two by two at 15px with 32px between rows, at the top. A gap of about 20svh follows. The wordmark spans the full width at the bottom; a name longer than ten letters stacks on two lines, each fitted to the width. Legal line beneath at 12px.

references.name: Cipher
references.idea: The showreel as a slowly turning wreath: a dozen film stills overlap in an elliptical ring around a tiny emblem on a black screen, with almost no text.
references.hero: The first capture is the preloader: a black screen textured with a fine grid of grey dots that thins out towards the right, the wordmark top-left and a tiny copyright glyph dead centre. Once loaded, the black screen holds a ring of about fourteen landscape film stills, each roughly 10% of the viewport wide, overlapping one another around an ellipse about 35% of the width; the centre is empty except for a 20px white emblem. The wordmark, about 11% wide, stays top-left. Four 9px uppercase links are split: one at the horizontal centre, three at the far right. A partner mark sits bottom-right. There is no headline.
references.type: Favorit only, and only at about 11px: uppercase nav links with slight tracking. The custom wordmark, with a macron and a schwa among its letters, is the sole large letterform. No headline and no body copy; one type size on the page.
references.colour: #070604 #ffffff #c9a45a #2f55c8 #c96a1e — Near-black ground with white micro-type. All colour comes from the stills: gold, cobalt blue, orange, garden green, plus one black-and-white frame.
references.imagery: Stills from fashion, beauty and fragrance films in 3:2 landscape crops, square-cornered and unframed, layered so each overlaps its neighbour by about a third. No captions or titles on them.
references.layout: A single non-scrolling stage. Navigation is pushed to the corners at tiny size and the ring of stills occupies the middle third; over half the screen is empty black. Scrolling rotates the ring instead of moving the page.
steal: Arrange work thumbnails as an overlapping elliptical ring with an empty centre, and bind scroll to rotation instead of vertical travel.
Shrink all text to one 11px uppercase size and let a custom wordmark be the only large type.
Give the preloader its own texture (a dot grid fading across the screen) rather than a spinner or percentage.
references.media: There is no document: one fixed canvas holds every picture as a texture, a ring of overlapping 16:9 film stills (about 240x135, overlapping their neighbours by 20-40%) round a tiny emblem, covering about 62% by 69% of the viewport, with the tiles themselves on 35-40% of the area and warm black between. No video elements; at least 35 distinct stills cycle through the ring.
references.motion: The dot-grid loader with a spinning chrome letter is still up at 4.5s. After that the wheel turns the ring instead of the page, sliding new stills in along the circular path with no fade or mask; nav letters roll on hover, and the few CSS transitions are transform .45s cubic-bezier(.83,.12,.35,.96) and opacity .2-.3s.

references.name: Kereliott
references.idea: A quiet house gets a quiet page: one dark field, one typeface, the name set as wide as the screen and photographs left to drift in generous darkness.
references.hero: Very dark green-black field with cream type. A two-line introductory sentence at about 30px sits top-left inside 30px margins; a small cream rectangular button sits top-right. The upper half is otherwise empty. The house name fills the full content width in a flared humanist sans, mixed case, with capitals about 19vw tall, its baseline at roughly 87% of the viewport height. Immediately beneath, separated by a gap of a few pixels, the top sliver of a full-width landscape photograph enters from the bottom edge.
references.type: A single face, Trust, in regular weight: a humanist sans with flared terminals and old-style figures. The wordmark is an oversized graphic; all other text is one size of about 20-30px plus tiny 10px photo captions. Hierarchy is position, not weight.
references.colour: #161c1a #eae8dc #222926 #1f2926 — Cream on green-black from top to bottom with no accent colour. The map is drawn in a tone barely lighter than the ground, so photographs supply all the colour.
references.imagery: Natural-light photos of a stone cottage, garden and deck with square corners, in mixed portrait and landscape crops at differing sizes. One full-width opener, then small images placed singly with tiny captions under the left corner.
references.layout: 30px margins, text held to the left 60% in one size. Photographs are staggered left and right at different widths with large dark gaps between, like pictures passed on a wall. The name and a booking button stay fixed in the top corners.

sections.description: A full-width landscape photograph runs margin to margin directly under the wordmark, followed after a gap by a four-line paragraph in the single text size, left-aligned and spanning about 85% of the width. There is no heading or label; the text simply continues the sentence begun at the top of the page.

After a left-aligned paragraph, a silhouette map of the region sits centre-left, about half the viewport wide, filled in a green only a few percent lighter than the background. Five towns are marked with small ring dots and tiny labels; only the house's town has a solid cream dot. No border, legend or frame.

Photographs are placed one or two per screen in a stagger: a portrait image about 30% wide against the left margin, a larger near-square one starting lower against the right margin, later a landscape image top-right of centre and a smaller one bottom-left. Each has a 10px caption under its left corner. More than half of every screen is empty dark ground.

Two short left-aligned sentences in the standard text size with underlined inline links to booking platforms and an email address, then a small cream certification badge. The footer is a single line at the very bottom: social link left, copyright centre, three underlined utility links right, with a tall empty gap above.

steal: Size the wordmark to fill the content width exactly and let the first photograph tuck directly under its baseline.
Draw a location map as a tone-on-tone silhouette with one filled dot among ring dots.
Use a single typeface in one weight and essentially one text size, creating hierarchy through placement and emptiness.

references.name: Berd
references.idea: The page types its own headlines into an empty app window, then hands over to toy-like 3D characters and ends on a giant red face delivering a joke testimonial.
references.archetype: other: typed statement in empty window frame
references.hero: A warm light-grey field covered by a faint dot grid, with no navigation at first. Centred, a single rounded rectangle 1000px wide and 710px tall (70% of the width, 79% of the height) in a lighter grey, with three tiny traffic-light dots in its top-left corner: an empty application window. In its exact centre a headline at about 42px is typed one character at a time; the capture shows only its first letter. Nothing else is on screen. On scroll the window gives way to 90px words typing onto the bare grid with a cursor line, and a small logo and a black download tag pin to the top corners.
references.type: Cash Sans at regular weight with -0.04em tracking for everything from 13px body to 90px typed statements; Cash Sans Mono in tiny uppercase for card headers and labels. Body copy is unusually small, so type is either huge or tiny.
references.colour: #e4e4e0 #f4f4f4 #000000 #c23e29 #fff200 — Grey on grey with black type for most of the page; colour arrives late and at full strength: glossy toy characters, then a red full-bleed close with yellow type and a yellow cursor disc.
references.imagery: Glossy 3D toy characters (jelly, cube, rock) as cut-outs on cards; looping demo videos inside black tiles with chamfered corners; a macro close-up of a red character's face filling the last screens.
references.layout: Each screen holds one thing: a window, a typed phrase, a horizontal row of square demo tiles bleeding off both edges, a fanned stack of cards with a small text block at left, a full-bleed face. Large empty grey intervals sit between them.

sections.description: A small centred title, then a single row of roughly 390px-square black tiles running off both sides of the page. Each tile has its four corners cut at 45 degrees, making an octagon, and holds a small inset demo video on black. Under each tile sit a centred one-line caption and a two-line grey quotation of the prompt at about 11px. The row scrolls sideways.

Left third: a tiny monospaced uppercase label, a two-line 24px heading and five lines of small grey text, vertically centred. Right: three portrait cards overlapping like a hand of trading cards, the middle one larger and in front. Each card is off-white with a mono header and serial number, a 3D character cut-out in the upper half, a name at 28px, a short description and two small columns divided by vertical rules.

The grey page ends and a macro video of a shiny red character's face fills the full width for more than a screen of height, eyes at the top and smile at the bottom. Across the nose a two-line quotation in bright yellow at about 90px types itself out, centred. A yellow disc with tiny text follows the pointer. Footer links run in small type along the bottom edge of the footage.

steal: Open on an empty application window and type the headline into it, so the first screen demonstrates the product's premise instead of describing it.
Cut the corners of square media tiles at 45 degrees to give a plain video row its own silhouette.
Save all saturated colour for the final screen: a full-bleed close-up with one oversized quotation set over it.
